introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: AI Pajak ('we', 'us', or 'our') operates an AI-powered tax filing platform under Indonesian law. This Privacy Policy is prepared in compliance with Undang-Undang Nomor 27 Tahun 2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (UU PDP / Indonesian Personal Data Protection Law) and explains how we collect, process, store, and protect your personal data when you use our services.

dataCollection.title: Personal Data We Collect
dataCollection.intro: We collect the following categories of personal data to provide our tax filing services:

items.identity: Identity data: Full legal name, Nomor Induk Kependudukan (NIK), Nomor Pokok Wajib Pajak (NPWP), date of birth, marital status, and number of dependents
items.contact: Contact data: Email address, phone number, and residential address
items.tax: Tax data: Income sources, salary information, tax withholding certificates (bukti potong), deduction details, and SPT form data (1770SS, 1770S, 1770, 1771)
items.financial: Financial data: Bank account details for refund processing, payment transaction records, and subscription billing history
items.usage: Technical data: Access logs, IP address, browser type, device information, and session data for security and service improvement purposes

dataUsage.title: Purpose of Data Processing
dataUsage.intro: We process your personal data for the following lawful purposes:

items.taxServices: Tax calculation and filing: To prepare, calculate, and submit your Surat Pemberitahuan (SPT) tax returns to Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP)
items.aiProcessing: AI-assisted analysis: To provide AI-powered tax calculations, deduction optimization suggestions, and document classification using Anthropic's AI technology
items.communication: Service communication: To send tax deadline reminders, filing status updates, and respond to your support inquiries
items.improvement: Service improvement: To analyze usage patterns (in anonymized/aggregated form) to improve platform features and user experience
items.legal: Legal compliance: To fulfill our obligations under Indonesian tax law, anti-money laundering regulations, and other applicable laws
items.security: Security: To detect, prevent, and respond to fraud, unauthorized access, and other security incidents

dataStorage.title: Data Storage and Infrastructure
dataStorage.content: Your personal data is stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL) databases with encryption at rest and in transit. Our application is hosted on Vercel's serverless infrastructure. All tax data is protected by Row Level Security (RLS) policies, ensuring that only authorized users can access their own data. Platform administrators are strictly blocked from accessing customer tax data as a core security principle.

dataProtection.title: Security Measures
dataProtection.content: We implement comprehensive security measures in accordance with UU PDP requirements, including: end-to-end encryption for data in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest; Row Level Security (RLS) at the database level ensuring data isolation between users; role-based access control (RBAC) with strict separation of duties; comprehensive audit trails for all tax-related operations; regular security assessments; and secure authentication through Supabase Auth with session management.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Data Sharing
thirdParty.intro: We share your data with the following third parties only as necessary to provide our services:

items.djp: Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP): Your tax data is submitted to DJP as required for tax filing through our authorized integration. This is a legal obligation under Indonesian tax law.
items.anthropic: Anthropic (AI Provider): Tax document data may be processed by Anthropic's AI models for calculation, classification, and optimization purposes. Data sent to Anthropic is used solely for processing your request and is not used to train AI models.
items.midtrans: Midtrans (Payment Gateway): Payment card details and transaction data are processed by Midtrans, a PCI DSS-compliant payment provider licensed by Bank Indonesia, to facilitate subscription payments.
items.jtc: Jakarta Tax Consulting (JTC): As our authorized tax consulting partner, JTC consultants may access your tax data to provide professional tax advisory services under a Power of Attorney arrangement.

thirdParty.noSale: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to any third party for marketing or other purposes.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We retain your tax information for a minimum of 5 (five) years from the end of the relevant tax year, in accordance with Indonesian tax regulations (UU KUP Pasal 28 ayat 11). After the retention period expires, your data will be securely deleted or anonymized, unless a longer retention period is required by law or ongoing legal proceedings. You may request earlier deletion of non-tax data at any time, subject to our legal obligations.

userRights.title: Your Rights Under UU PDP
userRights.intro: Under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP), you have the following rights:

items.access: Right to access: Obtain information about your personal data that we process, including the purpose of processing and the parties with whom it is shared
items.correction: Right to correction: Request correction or update of inaccurate or incomplete personal data
items.deletion: Right to deletion: Request deletion of your personal data when it is no longer necessary for the original purpose (subject to the 5-year tax retention requirement)
items.restriction: Right to restrict processing: Request that we limit the processing of your data under certain circumstances
items.objection: Right to object: Object to the processing of your personal data for specific purposes, including automated decision-making
items.portability: Right to data portability: Receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used format and transfer it to another service provider
items.withdrawal: Right to withdraw consent: Withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal

userRights.howTo: To exercise any of these rights, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@aipajak.com or through your account settings. We will respond to your request within 3x24 hours as required by UU PDP.

cookies.title: Cookies and Session Management
cookies.content: We use cookies strictly for session management and authentication purposes. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics cookies. Session cookies are automatically deleted when you log out or after your session expires. You can configure your browser to reject cookies, but this may affect your ability to use our services.

children.content: AI Pajak services are intended for individuals who are 17 years of age or older and who have tax obligations. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 17 years of age. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately.

aiDisclaimer.title: 4. AI Disclaimer and Limitations
aiDisclaimer.content: AI Pajak uses artificial intelligence technology (powered by Anthropic) to assist with tax calculations, document classification, and optimization suggestions. You acknowledge and agree that:

items.notAdvisor: AI Pajak is NOT a substitute for professional tax advice from a certified tax consultant (Konsultan Pajak). For complex tax situations, we strongly recommend consulting with a qualified tax professional.
items.verification: All AI-generated tax calculations, suggestions, and classifications should be reviewed and verified by you before submission. You bear ultimate responsibility for the accuracy of your tax filings.

items.humanReview: For tax filings processed through JTC, a certified tax consultant will review your submission before final filing with DJP.

platformLimitations.title: 5. Platform Limitations

items.availability: We strive for high availability but do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Planned maintenance and unexpected outages may occur.
items.djpDependency: Tax filing success depends on the availability and proper functioning of DJP's e-filing systems, which are outside our control.
items.regulations: Tax calculations are based on our understanding of current regulations. Changes in tax law may not be immediately reflected in our system.

We implement Row Level Security (RLS) at the database level, ensuring strict data isolation between users. Platform administrators are blocked from accessing customer tax data. A comprehensive audit trail records all tax-related operations. For full details on how we handle your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

help.faq1_q: How do I register on AI Pajak?
help.faq1_a: Click "Sign Up" on the main page and choose your account type (Individual / Company / External tax firm) at signup. You'll be taken straight to the dashboard tailored to your role — there is no separate onboarding wizard.
help.faq2_q: What do I need to get started?

help.faq3_a: Yes, there is a free plan with basic features (5 documents, 2 filings). Full features including AI are available on the Basic (IDR 199K/month) and Pro (IDR 499K/month) plans.
help.faq4_q: What's the difference between SPT 1770 SS, 1770 S, and 1770?
help.faq4_a:
1770 SS: For employees earning <IDR 60 million/year from a single employer.
1770 S: For employees earning ≥IDR 60 million/year or with multiple employers.
1770: For business owners or freelancers (doctors, lawyers, etc.).
help.faq5_q: How do I auto-fill the SPT?
help.faq5_a:
1) Go to "Annual SPT" menu → select form
2) Upload a photo/PDF of Withholding Certificate 1721-A1
3) AI will automatically read and fill in the data
4) Review the data and adjust if needed
5) Click "Generate SPT"
help.faq6_q: When is the SPT filing deadline?
help.faq6_a:
Individual Annual SPT: March 31 of the following year.
Corporate Annual SPT: April 30 of the following year.
Late penalties: IDR 100,000 (individual) or IDR 1,000,000 (corporate).
help.faq7_a: The 1721-A1 is a document issued by your employer containing annual salary and withheld tax data. It is usually provided at the beginning of the year or can be requested from your HR department.
help.faq8_q: How does AI OCR read documents?
help.faq8_a: AI uses Claude Vision technology to read text from photos/PDFs of tax documents. Upload clear, uncropped images for best results. Average accuracy is over 95%.
help.faq9_a: An AI feature that analyzes your tax data to find legitimate tax-saving opportunities. Examples: PTKP optimization, utilizing zakat deductions, or applying the 0.5% MSME rate.
help.faq10_q: How do I use the AI Chatbot?
help.faq10_a: Click the chat icon (💬) at the bottom right of any page. Ask anything about Indonesian taxes, and the AI will respond based on the latest regulations.
help.faq11_a: Yes. Data is encrypted end-to-end, stored on secure servers, and protected by Row Level Security (RLS). Even platform administrators cannot access your tax data (Hard Rule #1).
help.faq12_q: How is PPh Final for MSMEs calculated?
help.faq12_a: PPh Final MSME = 0.5% × Gross Revenue. Applies to taxpayers with revenue <IDR 4.8 billion/year. Per PP 55/2022, the first IDR 500 million is tax-exempt.
help.faq13_q: When is the monthly PPh Final payment due?
help.faq13_a: PPh Final for MSMEs must be paid by the 15th of the following month at the latest. Use the Tax Calendar feature for automatic reminders.
help.faq14_q: How do I import data from Shopee/Tokopedia?
help.faq14_a: Go to "E-commerce Import" menu → select platform → download CSV from Seller Dashboard → upload CSV. AI will automatically calculate revenue and PPh Final.
help.faq15_a: Clients register on AI Pajak themselves, then create a Power of Attorney (POA) designating you as their consultant. Once the POA is active, the client will appear on your dashboard.
help.faq16_a: An AI feature that analyzes client data to detect potential tax audit risks. It checks 9 categories: income changes, deduction ratios, effective tax rates, and more.
help.faq17_q: How do I create client reports?
help.faq17_a: Go to "Client Reports (AI)" menu → select client → select year → click "Generate Report". AI will create a comprehensive report with analysis and recommendations.
help.faq18_a: We accept: Bank Transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI), GoPay, OVO, DANA, Credit/Debit Cards, and Virtual Accounts via Midtrans.
help.faq19_q: How do I upgrade my plan?
help.faq19_a: Go to "Billing" menu → select desired plan → click "Upgrade" → complete payment. New features are activated immediately after successful payment.
help.faq20_a: Latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. We recommend Chrome for the best experience.
help.faq21_q: Can I use it on mobile?
help.faq21_a: Yes, AI Pajak is responsive and works on all devices. You can also add it as a PWA (Progressive Web App) to your home screen.
help.faq22_a: Use the AI Chatbot for general questions. For technical support, email support@aipajak.com or use the Chat feature in the "Messages" menu.

Upload all applicable:

pph25.fiscalAdjDesc: The process of converting accounting (commercial) profit to tax (fiscal) profit.
pph25.fiscalAdjFormula: Taxable Income (PKP) = Commercial Profit + Positive Adj - Negative Adj
pph25.negativeAdj: Negative Adjustment (Koreksi Negatif) - Non-taxable/Previously Taxed Income
pph25.taxCreditsDesc: Enter taxes already paid or withheld during the year. These amounts will be deducted from corporate tax.
pph25.pph22Hint: PPh 22 withheld by customs on imports
pph25.pph23Hint: PPh 23 withheld by business partners (total Bukti Potong)
pph25.pph24Hint: Taxes paid abroad (limited by DTA treaty)
pph25.smeDiscountNote: Revenue {revenue} <= Rp 50B: 50% discount on first Rp 4.8B
pph25.payBeforeSPT: Must be paid before SPT Tahunan submission (PPh 29).
pph25.diffReason1: Actual profit was higher than PPh 25 paid based on previous year
pph25.diffReason2: Fiscal adjustments (Koreksi Fiskal) increased taxable income
pph25.diffReason3: Some PPh 25 monthly installments were missed
pph25.paymentMethod: Payment method: AI will generate ID Billing
pph25.monthlyPaymentNote4: (Coretax / PMK 81/2024). If revenue changes significantly, adjustment can be requested via PMK-44.
pph25.sptTahunan1771: Prepare SPT Tahunan 1771 + Submit to DJP
pph25.corrEntertainmentHint: Art. 9(1)(e) Income Tax Law - Entertainment expenses are fully non-deductible. However, if a "Daftar Nominatif" (nominative list) is attached, up to 50% may be allowed.
pph25.corrWelfareDesc: Welfare - fully non-deductible except company-wide meals
pph25.corrWelfareHint: Only company-wide meals are 100% deductible. Individual meals, partial employee benefits, recreation are non-deductible.
pph25.corrDonationHint: Art. 9(1)(g) Income Tax Law - General donations are fully disallowed. National disaster and education/R&D donations partially allowed.
pph25.corrTaxPenaltyHint: Art. 9(1)(k) Income Tax Law - Tax-related penalties, surcharges, and interest sanctions are not deductible.
pph25.corrPersonalExpenseHint: Art. 9(1)(b) Income Tax Law - Personal expenses of shareholders/directors charged to the company.
pph25.corrPphBorneDesc: Company-borne employee income tax - fully non-deductible
pph25.corrPphBorneHint: Art. 9(1)(h) Income Tax Law - When the company bears employee PPh 21. Deductible if using Gross-up method.
pph25.corrProvisionHint: Art. 9(1)(c) Income Tax Law - Bad debt provisions, warranty provisions, etc. Only partially allowed for banking/insurance/leasing/mining.
pph25.corrDepreciationDiffDesc: Depreciation - fully deductible per tax rules
pph25.corrDepreciationDiffHint: Art. 11 Income Tax Law - Depreciation is fully deductible based on tax rules (Kelompok 1-4, buildings).
pph25.corrVehicleFuelDesc: Vehicle fuel - 50% deductible (100% with full receipts)
pph25.corrVehicleFuelHint: SE-09/PJ.42/2002 - Mixed-use vehicle fuel is only 50% deductible. 100% if proven business-only use.
pph25.corrTollExpenseHint: With all toll receipts, 100% deductible. With incomplete receipts, only 50%.
pph25.corrVehicleMaintHint: SE-09/PJ.42/2002 - Maintenance, insurance, and depreciation of mixed-use vehicles are only 50% deductible.
pph25.corrPhoneExpenseHint: Mixed-use phone/internet costs are only 50% deductible. 100% for company-dedicated lines.
pph25.corrHousingRentLabel: Employee housing rent (Biaya sewa rumah karyawan)
pph25.corrHousingRentDesc: Employee housing - deductibility per tax law
pph25.corrHousingRentHint: Art. 9(1)(e) & PMK-167/2018 - Employee housing rent is natura/kenikmatan. From 2024, deductible per PP 55/2022.
pph25.corrEducationFeeDesc: Education - deductible based on business relevance
pph25.corrEducationFeeHint: SE-27/PJ.22/1986 - Employee education/training directly related to work is 100% deductible.
pph25.corrTravelExpenseHint: Portions without receipts/documentation are not allowed. Adjust the rate.
pph25.corrOtherOpexDesc: Other - select rate for partial disallowance
pph25.corrOtherOpexHint: Other expenses not covered above. Select the disallowance rate.
pph25.corrPphFinalIncomeHint: Income already taxed under PPh Final (rent, UMKM, etc.). Excluded from corporate tax.
pph25.corrNonTaxableIncomeHint: Dividends from subsidiaries with 25%+ ownership, etc.
pph25.corrDepreciationDiffNegHint: Difference when tax depreciation exceeds commercial depreciation.

statements.aiNote: AI Comment: Carefully review bank transactions vs sales list differences, cash sales, calculated expenses, and missing fixed assets.

adjust.title: Fiscal adjustment (Koreksi Fiskal)
adjust.subtitle: Convert accounting profit → taxable profit. Taxable Income (PKP) → Positive + Negative Adjustments.

entertainment.title: Biaya entertainment (Entertainment Expenses)
entertainment.body: Article 9(1)(k) Income Tax Law — Expenses not recognized if details of payer/venue/amount are incomplete.

welfare.title: Biaya kesejahteraan karyawan (Employee Welfare Expenses)
welfare.body: Employee welfare expenses not subject to tax treatment are 100% disallowed.

donation.title: Sumbangan/donasi (Donations)
donation.body: Donations other than allowable donations are disallowed.

penalty.title: Denda & sanksi pajak (Fines & Tax Penalties)
penalty.body: Article 9(1)(k) — Tax penalties are not recognized as expenses.

private.title: Biaya pribadi (Personal Expenses of Shareholders/Directors)
private.body: Personal expenses unrelated to the company are 100% disallowed.

pphBorne.title: PPh ditanggung perusahaan (PPh Borne by Company)
pphBorne.body: PPh borne by company is disallowed unless gross-up treatment is applied.

vehicle.title: Biaya BBM kendaraan (Company Vehicle Fuel Expenses)

carBenefit.title: Biaya tol (Toll Expenses)
carBenefit.body: Only 50% allowable except for official business trips.

phone.title: Biaya telepon/pulsa (Communication Expenses)
phone.body: 50% of company telecommunication expenses are deductible.

houseRent.title: Biaya sewa rumah karyawan (Employee housing rent)
houseRent.body: 100% non-deductible except for remote/isolated area workers.

travel.title: Biaya perjalanan dinas (Business travel expenses)
travel.body: 40% non-deductible if supporting documents are insufficient.

operating.title: Biaya operasional lainnya (Other operating expenses)
operating.body: 50% non-deductible if supporting evidence is insufficient.

otherPositive.title: Koreksi positif lainnya (Other positive adjustments)
otherPositive.body: Free input for other positive adjustment items.

pphFinal.title: Penghasilan PPh Final (Income subject to PPh Final)
pphFinal.body: Income separately taxed under PPh Final should be deducted.

nonObjek.title: Penghasilan bukan objek pajak (Non-taxable income)
nonObjek.body: Non-taxable income such as dividends, treasury stock disposal, etc.

depDiff.title: Selisih penyusutan (Accounting/tax depreciation difference)
depDiff.body: Difference between accounting and tax depreciation.

otherNegative.title: Koreksi negatif lainnya (Other negative adjustments)
otherNegative.body: Free input for other negative adjustment items.

sign.title: Print, sign, re-upload statements
sign.subtitle: The generated financial statements must be printed in official format, signed by the representative, and re-uploaded. This signed document will be uploaded to the government as official documentation when filing the resulting Coretax return.
sign.aiNote: AI Verification: Automatically checks bank transaction revenue list differences, cash sales, calculated expenses, and missing fixed assets.
sign.hint: You must complete the signed document upload to proceed to the next step.

credit.title: Tax credit (Kredit Pajak)
credit.subtitle: Enter tax amounts already paid during the year to be credited against your final settlement.

pph22.label: PPh 22 (Import Withholding)
pph22.desc: Total PPh 22 imposed during import clearance

pph23.label: PPh 23 (Service Withholding)
pph23.desc: Withholding tax deducted by customers on our revenue

pph24.label: PPh 24 (Foreign Tax Credit)
pph24.desc: Foreign tax credit on overseas source income

calc.title: Calculate 2025 corporate tax (PPh Badan)
calc.creditLabel: PPh 22 Credit / PPh 23 Credit / PPh 24 Credit / PPh 25 Credit

monthly.title: Calculate 2026 PPh 25 monthly installment
monthly.note: PPh 25 for 2026 must be paid monthly Rp 0 by the 10th of each month (Coretax / PMK 81/2024). Adjustment applications under PMK-44 are possible when revenue fluctuates.
